featured_title: Miromar Lakes vs Grandezza Estero FL: What Does $630,000 Buy You in Each? 2026
featured_excerpt: At about $630,000, Miromar Lakes and Grandezza buy similar square footage and nearly identical tax bills, but the yearly bill is built differently: Grandezza adds a mandatory social club, while Miromar Lakes stacks condo, master and CDD fees, and neither is a blanket no-flood-zone answer.
others_caption: Also this week: West Bay Club and whether you have to join the golf club, Copper Oaks in Estero and whether to buy a single-family home or a town villa, how to read a CDD budget before you buy in Estero, why Amendment 3 makes December 31, 2026 a date to know for relocating buyers, Marsh Landing's two-board purchase approval, whether your buyer can actually insure your home, what Amendment 3 means for Southwest Florida homeowners, Cascades at Estero after its builder's bankruptcy, and Grandezza vs Wildcat Run on which club sets your dues.
